title: Make a Hot Spiced Milk Drink

steps.do: Rinse the mug under running water and empty it
steps.done_when: The empty mug is on the counter beside the sink and no water is running into it

steps.do: Pour {milk} of milk into the mug and cap the milk bottle
steps.done_when: The mug on the counter is filled with white milk and the milk bottle beside it is capped

steps.do: Heat the mug of milk in the microwave, then remove the mug
steps.done_when: The mug of milk is on the counter beside the closed microwave

steps.do: Add {ground_cinnamon} of ground cinnamon to the mug
steps.done_when: Brown cinnamon powder is visible in the milk in the mug

steps.do: Add {sugar} of sugar to the mug
steps.done_when: White sugar is visible on the surface of the drink in the mug and the measuring spoon is on the counter

steps.do: Stir the drink until the cinnamon and sugar are mixed in
steps.done_when: The drink in the mug is evenly mixed and frothy with no dry powder visible on its surface

steps.do: Heat the drink in the microwave for {second_microwave_time}, then remove the mug
steps.done_when: The mug of drink is on the counter by the stove and the microwave door is closed with no mug inside
